prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: side impact at intersection in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1278; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant later added small details, but the account stayed the same.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving through the intersection on a green light when another vehicle entered from the cross street and struck the driver's side of my car. The impact spun my vehicle partway around and I felt a sharp pain in my right shoulder right away. I stayed at the scene until the police arrived and gave them my account. Over the following days I remembered a few more small details, such as the position of the other car's headlights and the sound of the brakes, but the core of what happened has not changed since that first moment. I am the named driver on this policy and I have provided my insurance information and vehicle details to the officer at the scene. My shoulder has been sore since the collision and I have started physical therapy.
